::: {.wow-turquoise}
# AI Engineering for Government Modernization
:::

Balans is a solo data and AI engineering practice for public-sector institutions. I build local, in-process, on-device solutions that keep your data private and under your control, designed to meet WCAG 2.2 accessibility targets and align with FAIR principles, without vendor lock-in or long-term contracts.

[Start a conversation](mailto:adam@balans.ca){.cta}

::: {.pitch-card}
## Collaborate with me when:  
- You need a **completed project**, not another platform subscription.   
- Your mandate has a **hard deadline**.   
- Your **budget** rules out multi-year vendor relationships.   
- Your data assets must be processed on infrastructure you **can control and audit**.   
:::

::: {.wow-turquoise}
# Why Government Modernization Needs a New Approach
:::

Government IT modernization is often sold as a platform, a subscription, a dashboard, a multi-year contract that outlives the mandate it was built for. I work differently.

## Embedded, Scoped, Handed Over

I work embedded with your team, within your constraints, until the deliverable is complete and handed over. After that, you decide whether to extend the engagement or close it.

::: {.pitch-card}
## Built for Public Sector Reality: 
- **Local-first, sovereign by default**: Data and models run on infrastructure you control.
- **No vendor lock-in**: Deliverables include complete code, documentation, and training.
- **Project-based**: Defined scope, defined end date, fits standard contracting vehicles.
- **Standards-aligned from day one**: Built to WCAG 2.2 AA (AAA criteria where feasible) and aligned with FAIR data principles.
:::

::: {.wow-turquoise}
# What I Deliver
:::

::: {.quote-box}
Fix the data, make it actionable, add on advanced capabilities---with compliance and sovereignty as underlying principles.
:::

## Data Engineering
Custom pipelines and modern analytical infrastructure that turn raw data into actionable assets, with scalability in mind. Ideal for departments consolidating legacy systems or preparing for AI-enabled initiatives.

## Reporting & Analytical Deliverables
Actionable insights through reports, notebooks, dashboards, and AI layers that draw on your project's data and your team's knowledge.

## AI/ML Engineering
From proof-of-concept to working deployment, I build solutions for real-world problems with transparency and fairness at the core, specializing in on-device inference for maximum data control.

## Strategy, Governance & Compliance
I help align your data with organizational goals, regulatory requirements (ATIP, Privacy Act), and best practices (WCAG, FAIR), so you go into departmental review well prepared.

## Sovereign Tooling
Local, in-process, on-device inference and tooling by default, supporting data sovereignty, privacy, and full auditability. No third-party cloud routing unless you explicitly choose it.


::: {.wow-turquoise}
# Service Tiers
:::

Every engagement is scoped before it's priced—the tiers below are for planning purposes, not a binding quote.

::: {.pricing-cards}
## Scope
In-depth data audit, FAIR assessment, scoping report.  

**Timeline:** 4–6 weeks  
**Price:** $7,500 – $9,500  

## Architect
Data cleaning, vault/lake structuring, pipeline development.  

**Timeline:** 8–12 weeks  
**Price:** $35,000 – $80,000  

## Enable
End-to-end build, SQL/reporting layer, local LLM integration, training materials.  

**Timeline:** 12 weeks+  
**Price:** $85,000 – $140,000  
:::

<small>*Prices exclude applicable taxes. Final pricing depends on data volume, schema complexity, and current data quality. A scoping phase is required before build work, and the scoping report is yours to use however you choose.*</small>

## About the name

Several cultures share the idea of something being “just right” (not too much, not too little). Like the Earth’s axial tilt, a small but well-placed adjustment can be what makes everything feel optimized, well-balanced. That’s the standard I hold myself to.
